purpose: One local, SNE-owned inference-session telemetry publication consumed by Stack Lab, Apollo, Ma'at, CLI, native app, dashboard, TUI, and MCP without a parallel observer or fabricated metric.

ownership.capacity_authority: SNE-qualified local hardware and inference admission
prohibitions: Pantheon must not invent a model, machine, chip estate, throughput, bandwidth, residency, or remote capacity
a Stack Lab plan must not be treated as an inference admission or launch receipt
a missing session sample must be rendered as awaiting_session, never as zero activity or healthy completion
Pantheon must not modify, start, stop, or reconfigure SNE while reading telemetry

capability_catalog.machines: selectable typed capacity receipts; `machine` is retained only for v1-compatible consumers
selection_rules: all limits are explicit typed quantities
the selected machine must be present in `machines` with its own typed capacity receipt; Pantheon never borrows this Mac's limits for a named peer
the engine must be configured and machine_id-bound to the selected machine
every selected estate must be detected and enumerated by the selected machine receipt
a selected estate that is not currently available remains explicit in unavailable_chip_estates; it is user-selectable but SNE must qualify and admit it before inference can start
swap is a request ceiling; SNE admission checks live pressure independently

publisher_requirements: publish a complete regular non-symlink file atomically after an SNE-admitted session starts
replace, never append, each session sample
write only measured values; omit any metric SNE did not measure
remove or publish a terminal non-active sample when the session ends
preserve publisher provenance outside Pantheon; Pantheon is a read-only consumer
validity_rules: all rates and byte counts are non-negative
all percentages are finite and between 0 and 100 inclusive
chip-estate ids are nonempty and unique
unknown properties reject the complete sample
Pantheon opens the telemetry leaf with no-follow semantics and requires descriptor/path identity continuity before and after two byte-identical reads

consumer_states.awaiting_session: No valid SNE sample exists. Keep the selected plan available, show the SNE admission route, and allow refresh or plan adjustment.
consumer_states.active: A complete valid session sample exists. Render every measured metric with its unit and label omitted metrics unavailable.
consumer_states.invalid: A sample exists but is unsafe or malformed. Reject it, retain no false active state, surface the exact validation issue, and route to Ma'at evidence.

upgrade_recipe: add a schema revision rather than widening v2 ambiguously
add positive, omitted-metric, duplicate-estate, bad-percentage, unknown-field, atomic-replacement, and terminal-session fixtures
obtain SNE source and runtime qualification before publishing telemetry from a new engine
verify identical semantics in CLI, native app, dashboard, TUI, MCP, and Ma'at before release
